title: "2/11"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
housing <- read.csv("https://jericholawson.github.io/classes/sds192/s26/data/housing.csv")
```

```{r}
dim(housing)
#numerical = housing median age, total rooms, bedrooms, population, households, median income, 
#catagorical = latitude, longitude, median house value, ocean proximity
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = housing,
aes( x = ocean_proximity,
     fill = ocean_proximity)+
    geom_bar()+
  labs(title= "Frequencies of Groups of Ocean Proximity for California Districts, 1990",
       fill= "ocean_proximity") +
xlab ("Ocean Proximity")+
ylab("Frequency") 
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = housing,
aes( x = ocean_proximity,
     y = median_income,
     fill = ocean_proximity)+
    geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title= "Distribution of Median Household Income (in 1000s) by Ocean Proximity to California Districts, 1990",
       fill= "ocean_proximity") +
xlab("Ocean Proximity")+
ylab("Median_Income") 
```
